name: Fighter Vengeance Bringer
body:
A vengeance bringer is a fighter that focuses on techniques that allow them to strike down any who would deign to harm them or one with whom they have been tasked with meting out vengeance, typically by a deity or political force.

Bringer of Vengeance (Ex)

Starting with 2nd level, a vengeance bringer gains a +1 bonus on Intimidate, Perception, and Sense Motive against a target for whom you have been tasked with bringing vengeance. You also gain a +1 bonus on damage and attack rolls against the target. You must be tasked by an organization or other quest-giver to gain these benefits as decided by the GM.

These bonuses increase by +1 for every four levels beyond 2nd. This ability replaces bravery.

Mystic Backlash (Su)

At 4th level, a vengeance bringer punishes a spellcaster that attempts to affect them. Anytime they succeed at a saving throw against a spell that specifically targets them, the vengeance bringer sends a mystic reverberation back to the caster, dealing them 1d6 nonlethal damage.

This damage increases by 1d6 every 4 levels beyond 4th. This ability replaces a bonus feat gained at 4th and 12th levels.

Counterattack (Ex)

At 10th level, a vengeance bringer can make an attack of opportunity as an immediate action against an opponent who hits them with a melee attack, so long as the attacking creature is within the vengeance bringer’s reach or if the attack was a natural attack. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 10th level.
